payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to develop per-triple templates, including hand-crafted templates and transformations of triples into facts using defined templates for each predicate.

claims.text: Per-triple templates were developed using hand-crafted templates for each predicate, transforming triples into facts.
The transformation of triples to facts serves to prepare data for subsequent operations and introduce in-domain knowledge.
The templates were created manually for all predicates in the datasets used, including unseen predicates.
